default.notes: Apply online for an Armenian e-Visa (21 or 120 days); most e-Visa-eligible nationalities can alternatively obtain a visa on arrival at Zvartnots Airport — check current eligibility on evisa.mfa.am.

groups.notes: Visa-free entry for up to 180 days per calendar year under Armenia's waiver decrees and bilateral agreements.
On Armenia's invitation list — a visa requires supporting documents and is issued through an Armenian embassy rather than online; check evisa.mfa.am for the current requirements.

AM.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Armenian citizens.

IR.notes: Visa-free under the Armenia–Iran bilateral agreement — stays of up to 90 days.

AZ.notes: Armenia and Azerbaijan have no diplomatic relations — entry for Azerbaijani citizens requires prior clearance from the Armenian authorities and is rarely straightforward; enquire well in advance.

XK.notes: Armenia does not recognise Kosovo — Kosovo-issued passports are generally not accepted; contact an Armenian mission about travel options.
